translations.Talk-Bot answers through AI-Hub. The AI: Talk-Bot answers through AI-Hub. The AI service, key and model are set in AI-Hub, under Administration settings → AI-Hub, and the same AI-Hub serves the other apps too. Below are only the settings specific to Talk.
translations.AI-Hub is not installed, so the bot cann: AI-Hub is not installed, so the bot cannot answer yet. Install it from the App Store (search for "AI-Hub"), then set the AI service, key and model in its settings.
translations.AI-Hub is installed but not set up yet,: AI-Hub is installed but not set up yet, so the bot cannot answer. Open Administration settings → AI-Hub and choose the AI service, key and model.
translations.A language code such as en, ja or de to: A language code such as en, ja or de to force one language for everyone. Leave empty to answer each user in the language they chose in Nextcloud.
translations.Added to every conversation, for example: Added to every conversation, for example a tone of voice or facts about your organization.
translations.Restrict the bot to selected users: Restrict the bot to selected users
translations.When off, anyone in a conversation where: When off, anyone in a conversation where the bot is enabled can use it.
translations.Comma-separated user IDs, used only whil: Comma-separated user IDs, used only while the restriction above is on.
translations.Days to keep a conversation's history: Days to keep a conversation's history
translations.What the bot remembers of a conversation: What the bot remembers of a conversation is forgotten this many days after its last message. 0 = kept until the conversation is reset with ?reset.
translations.Answers in progress at once, per user: Answers in progress at once, per user
translations.Answers in progress at once, for everyon: Answers in progress at once, for everyone together
translations.Each answer keeps one PHP worker busy un: Each answer keeps one PHP worker busy until it is done. 0 = no limit.
translations.AI-Hub is not installed, so I can't answ:
AI-Hub is not installed, so I can't answer yet. An administrator needs to set it up:
1. As an administrator, open Apps and search for "AI-Hub".
2. Press Download and enable.
3. Open Administration settings → AI-Hub and choose the AI service, key and model.
Then talk to me again.
AI-Hub is installed but not set up yet. An administrator needs to open Administration settings → AI-Hub and choose the AI service, key and model.
translations.Too many requests at once. Please wait a: Too many requests at once. Please wait a moment and ask again.
translations.The model tried to use a tool it does no: The model tried to use a tool it does not have. Please ask again.
translations.Something went wrong. An administrator c: Something went wrong. An administrator can find the details in the Nextcloud log.
translations.Conversation reset. I have forgotten wha: Conversation reset. I have forgotten what we talked about.
AI-Hub is required and is not installed.
AI-Hub is installed but not set up yet.
translations.AI-Hub is required and is not installed,: AI-Hub is required and is not installed, so there is no model yet. An administrator needs to install and set it up.
AI-Hub is installed but not set up yet. An administrator chooses the AI service, key and model in Administration settings → AI-Hub.
translations.I answer through AI-Hub, model %s. The A: I answer through AI-Hub, model %s. The AI service and model are set in AI-Hub.
translations.Talk-Bot now answers through AI-Hub. The: Talk-Bot now answers through AI-Hub. The AI service, model and any command line tool are managed in AI-Hub — open Administration settings → AI-Hub to change or update them.
translations.You are %s. Everyone here talks to the s: You are %s. Everyone here talks to the same AI-Hub assistant.
pong — I am here and listening.
There is nothing to undo yet.
There is nothing to answer again yet.
translations.There is no conversation to summarize ye: There is no conversation to summarize yet.
translations.I did not understand that. Try ?roll, ?r: I did not understand that. Try ?roll, ?roll 20 or ?roll 2d6.
translations.This conversation replies in \"%s\". Use: This conversation replies in "%s". Use ?lang off to follow each user instead.
translations.This conversation follows the server def: This conversation follows the server default ("%s"). Set another with ?lang <code>.
translations.This conversation replies in each user's: This conversation replies in each user's own language. Set a fixed one with ?lang <code>, e.g. ?lang en.
translations.Reply language cleared — I will follow e: Reply language cleared — I will follow each user's language.
That does not look like a language code. Try ?lang en, ?lang ja or ?lang off.
translations.This conversation will now reply in \"%s: This conversation will now reply in "%s".
translations.Only a moderator of this conversation ca: Only a moderator of this conversation can change its reply language.
translations.forget the conversation and start over: forget the conversation and start over
translations.set the reply language for this conversa: set the reply language for this conversation (e.g. ?lang en; ?lang off to follow each user's language)
translations.show the AI-Hub connection and memory: show the AI-Hub connection and memory
translations.show the model AI-Hub answers with: show the model AI-Hub answers with
translations.where to manage the AI service and model: where to manage the AI service and model
translations.Anything else you write is answered by t: Anything else you write is answered by the model.
